notes.providerDrift: Absolute provider input-token values across campaigns are not directly comparable: provider-side context (system prompt, tool schema, cached framework context) can change between campaigns even with an identical agent and model version. Only same-campaign paired reductions are valid performance evidence.
notes.weighting: runWeighted pools every paired run, so repositories with more tasks or repetitions weigh more. repoWeighted treats each repository x agent campaign as one unit and reports mean and median of per-campaign reductions; repo median is the primary generalization signal.
notes.precision: Expected-file source precision is a focus proxy. A non-expected file is not necessarily useless.
notes.missingValues: null means not applicable / not measured (rendered n/a), never zero.

overall.note: Pools all agents. Prefer byAgent for agent-specific claims; agents are never summed into one score.

coverage.note: Pairs with a failed invocation on either side are coverage gaps and are excluded from every performance aggregate.

determinism.note: Coefficient of variation across repetitions of the same task and condition. Describes run-to-run stability only; it is not a correctness measure.
